Tennessee farmer refused $20 an acre for national park land
description: In 1929, Tennessee farmer John W. Oliver refused to sell his 375-acre Cades Cove farm for $20 an acre, leading to a lengthy court battle over land wanted for Great Smoky Mountains National Park. After the Tennessee Supreme Court ruled against him, Oliver ultimately lost his property and received $17,000 in 1935.

title: August 12 solar eclipse: Europe set for first total eclipse in 27 years
description: Europe will witness its first total solar eclipse in twenty-seven years on August twelfth.  Millions across Iceland and northern Spain will experience this rare celestial event.  Nasa will livestream the eclipse for viewers outside the path of totality.  Americans will see a partial eclipse, while Canada also observes it.  This eclipse begins an unusual period of significant celestial occurrences.

title: Jaguar TCS Racing sets world record with 29 runners over 100km
description: Jaguar TCS Racing has marked the end of the Formula E GEN3 era in a unique way. Ahead of the London E-Prix, 29 runners from Jaguar TCS Racing and Tata Consultancy Services covered more than 100km across London to create a GPS drawing of the Jaguar I-TYPE 7. The effort helped the team set a Guinness World Record before its home season finale.

title: Undertaker and Michelle McCool’s combined net worth in 2026
description: The Undertaker and Michelle McCool maintain significant wealth through various post-wrestling ventures.  Their combined net worth is estimated between 21-22.5 million dollars in 2026.  The Undertaker's legendary WWE career and ongoing media work contribute substantially to his fortune.  Michelle McCool also leverages her wrestling legacy for continued commercial opportunities and income.  Their financial success demonstrates enduring value from wrestling careers even after retirement.

title: Middle East standoff: Why Gulf states may accept that Iran will control Hormuz
description: Gulf energy producers have acknowledged Iran's assertion of control over the critical Strait of Hormuz. This development occurs amidst attempts to resume passage through this essential route, which are stymied by ongoing tensions. Governments in the region prioritize peace over export delays, while Iran aims for financial easing and a prohibition of international warships, extending the disruption of global energy channels.

70 dead, 204 roads blocked: Himachal reels under monsoon fury; damage tops Rs 910 cr
description: Himachal Pradesh has been severely affected by monsoon rains, resulting in 70 fatalities and 204 roadblocks. Damages to public property have skyrocketed to over Rs 910 crore. The primary causes of these tragic deaths include landslides and mishaps from steep terrains. Additionally, 93 lives were lost due to road accidents during this challenging period. Restoration efforts are ongoing but are significantly hindered by continuous rain, creating additional hazards.

title: Google office tour goes viral as free food, game rooms and classes divide social media
description: An intriguing glimpse into a Google office in San Francisco became an online sensation. The tour revealed quirky features, like a Back to the Future-themed meeting space. Employees benefit from three meals a day, complemented by snacks available on every floor, showcasing a plethora of breakfast and lunch options. This sparked conversations on social media about the balance between these enticing perks and the reality of work-life balance.

title: Trump's Turkey takeout: World's most protected man spirited out in catering container
description: In a covert operation to ensure President Trump's safety, his security team reportedly employed a catering vehicle to transport him from a decoy aircraft in Turkey, responding to credible Iranian threats. This complex plan involved a smaller airplane ferrying him to Britain while a decoy remained in view, highlighting the ongoing challenges of protecting a president using foreign-supplied aircraft.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ controversial confession sparks fitness debate ahead of new season
description: Patrick Mahomes' recent confesion about his wealth has sparked a massive debate about his fitness as many remain worried about him.

title: Old allies, new equation? Why SAD and BJP may join hands for Punjab polls
description: Haryana chief minister Nayab Singh Saini has categorically denied any prospective alliance with Shiromani Akali Dal for 2027 Punjab assembly elections. However, recent discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal have led to renewed speculation around possible tie-up. After the meeting, SAD, whose electoral fortunes have waned significantly, changed its perspective on delimitation. The BJP is reportedly keen on dominating any potential alliance.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees
description: Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings.

title: Connecticut woman builds 725-square-foot backyard cottage for retired parents
Mark Zuckerberg's $300M yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
description: Mark Zuckerberg's superyacht Launchpad faced criticism after a stranded boat incident. The vessel's crew was reportedly on a different radio channel during the emergency. Help was already en route when the yacht's crew reviewed the assistance request. The yacht, valued at $390 million, was closer to the distressed skiff. Passengers on a nearby cruise ship booed the yacht's perceived inaction.
